evidence.detail: The nested enum preserves exactly three source-visible constants: TEXTURES, RANDOMIZE and RECOLOR.

Its sole exact-v308 owner is R311 TextureDebugConfigLoader, whose ./debug/textures.txt parser switches section state on [textur], [random] and [recolor] markers before routing parsed integer rows into the matching lists.
The enum is used only as the loader's current section selector while parsing that debug configuration file and carries no unrelated state.

candidates.note: Source-like exact-v308 identity for the section selector nested inside R311 TextureDebugConfigLoader.
